name: Leon
source: Warm, charismatic, and confident. Leon has a passion for rescuing animals and a penchant for nicknaming everyone. He seems to have a good relationship with the Show Mistress. Though he’s friendly and openly flirtatious, he doesn’t like talking about his past.
translation: Warm, charismatic, and confident. Leon has a passion for rescuing animals and a penchant for nicknaming everyone. He seems to have a good relationship with the Show Mistress. Though he’s friendly and openly flirtatious, he doesn’t like talking about his past.
